title: Taking a suffix of a segment
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F$ a set of states, and $P$ a predicate on work-tape head positions. If a segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $t$ avoids $F$ before time $t$, satisfies $P$ at every time from $0$ through $t$, and $u\le t$, then the run starting at the configuration reached from $a$ after $u$ steps is a segment to $b$ of length $t-u$ relative to $F$ and $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A segment from $a$ to $b$ of length $t$ relative to $F$ and $P$
